subject: Lighthouse weekly: numbers + handoff slate
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Lighthouse weekly: numbers + handoff slate

Team — quick kickoff for this week's numbers lighthouse. Goal: get the weekly submission locked, flag any at-risk Atlas AI deals, and confirm owner handoffs for the Thursday commit call. Please do the three items below by EOD Wednesday PST so we can run the pre-call triage on Thursday morning.

1) Update SFDC close dates and stage to the exact stage token ("Lighthouse - Commit") for any deals you plan to move into the commit lane. If you change close date, add a one-line reason in the notes.
2) Upload the short numbers template (attached) to the Deal > Files and add the record link to the HubSpot deal record.
3) Add an explicit owner for the post-commit ops handoff (CS, RevOps) in the "Next Steps" field.

Attachments: numbers-lighthouse-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Call: Thu 11/26 09:00 PST — invite already on calendar (see related link).

Call agenda (so the pre-call runs clean):
- 09:00-09:10: quick lane read (who's dropping out)
- 09:10-09:30: 5 priority deals (one deck slide each)
- 09:30-09:45: ops handoff / billing flags
- 09:45-10:00: escalation items & decisions

If you have any seller-level objections (discount asks, custom SLA) flag them under "Escalation" on the sheet and loop Marissa.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

I'll upload the numbers template now either way.

— Ben
